title: 9B prompt-reading recheck: 20 interleaved stock/fork passes with GPU telemetry
command: 20 alternating-order pairs of `python run_stock.py --pack ~/.kindi/packs/bonsai-9b --ctx 8192 bench` (stock v0.6.1 + libcuda shim) and `KINDI_TP=0 python -m kindi --pack ~/.kindi/packs/bonsai-9b --ctx 8192 bench --split-at off` (fork 549e0cf), with 50 ms nvidia-smi clock/power sampling
notes: The 2026-11-17 five-pass 9B reading gap (83.9 stock vs 72.4 fork) did not reproduce. Twenty fresh-process passes per side (order alternated) give 70.7 and 75.7; the paired stock-minus-fork median is -1.4 tok/s, the bootstrap interval spans zero, and the exact sign test is p=0.648. The cell is a sub-second 20-token burst that sat mostly in P5/P8, so it is closed as noise and no reading difference is claimed.
